card.name: Partway through names before the ending
card.fires_on: Partway through a proper name or drug name where the rest of the name is still to come, such as dexam<eth>asone, Sprague-Daw<ley>, or a space before a place number. It is strongest in the middle of corticosteroid names.

modes.label: Steroid drug names
modes.description: Inside glucocorticoid names such as dexamethasone or prednisone, just before the ending.

modes.label: Other proper names
modes.description: Inside place, animal-strain, brand or product names, or a trial code, before the final piece.
modes.example: Sprague-Daw<<ley>> female rats fed dantrolene sodium

card.writes: It adds little, but it slightly favors retrieval and join-like tokens and suppresses word endings, so the name tends to be finished by other means.
card.plain: It lights up in the middle of a long name, such as dexamethasone, when the name is not yet finished.
